notes.title: Bugfix Release
notes.notes:
A new bugfix release is out. This fixes several stability issues on Windows and MacOS:


 Windows: Fix issue with Windows exceptions causing the game to crash, usually in relation to certain antivirus programs like Avast.
 MacOS: Fix sound playback issues for devices with samplerates higher than 44.1kHz
 MacOS: Improve sound playback performance
 MacOS: Fix scaling issues arising from HiDPI displays


Thank you for your patience and for playing Eternia!
